milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because crafting jungle planks from jungle logs places the planks directly into the player's inventory. The player starts with jungle_log (not jungle_planks), so this rule has no false positives at scene start. Verified via sandbox: hotbar shows only jungle_log and spruce_planks initially.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a spruce door from spruce planks on a crafting table places the door item directly into the player's inventory. The player starts with spruce_planks (not spruce_door), so this rule has no false positives at scene start. The crafting table required for the 3x2 door recipe must first be crafted from jungle_planks (Task 1 output), enforcing the dependency naturally.
